name: web-dark-product-features-bento-with-10x-toggle-shortcut-and-integrations
title: Black 'Product Features' bento: Zapier integration with a red toggle, connected trackers, a giant 10X, focus analytics with an orange tag and shortcut keys
whatItIs: A near-black page with a centred heading and grey subline above bordered dark cards: a tall Zapier Integration card with an orange-green logo, a description, a Configure button and a red toggle; a 'Trackers Connected' card with avatars; a '10X' card with huge grey numerals; a 'Focusing' card with '42%' and an orange Range Ratio pill; a Team's Productivity card; and a wide Shortcut Keys card with keycaps.
whatItMeans: Technical and orderly; big numerals and small controls show product depth quickly.
techniques: Use giant numerals as a graphic tile.
Show real controls (toggle, button) in cards.
Add one orange tag as an accent.

vocabulary.definition: A card built around a giant number.
A small key-shaped label for a shortcut.
A functional switch shown inside a card.
A single coloured pill in a dark set.
